request-prompt: In the product modules, make the 'Save $X' discount text significantly larger and highlighted in green to instantly emphasize the monetary value over the product's brand.
goal: I am brand-agnostic and prioritize getting the absolute best value or lowest price, even if the brand is relatively obscure.
jobs: I want to find extended Memorial Day sales on tech products to save money on my next electronics purchase.
I want to browse discounted gadgets categorized by price (such as under $50, under $100, or under $250) to quickly find deals within my budget.
I want to read expert summaries and reviews of on-sale items to determine if a specific product (like the AirPods Pro 3 or Apple Watch Series 11) is right for me.
I want to see the exact discount amount and compare the sale price with the original retail price to evaluate how good the deal is.
I want to easily click through to a trusted retailer like Amazon to purchase a featured item before the limited-time discount expires.

preference-pairs.a: I am strictly loyal to premium, well-known tech brands like Apple or Bose and rarely consider budget or lesser-known alternatives.
preference-pairs.b: I am brand-agnostic and prioritize getting the absolute best value or lowest price, even if the brand is relatively obscure.

preference-pairs.a: I highly trust curated lists and recommendations from tech editors and journalists to guide my buying decisions.
preference-pairs.b: I am highly skeptical of affiliate-driven editorial reviews and prefer to do my own independent research on user forums and specs.

preference-pairs.a: I am a deal hunter who enjoys buying gadgets impulsively simply because they are marked down to an all-time low price.
preference-pairs.b: I only buy tech accessories and electronics when I have a specific, pre-determined need for them, regardless of how good a temporary discount is.
